However, this kind of control is affected by the errors introduced by discretization and quantization and may require floating-point Digital Signal Processors (DSP) for proper implementation. This paper addresses the issues related to the implementation of resonant current control using low-cost, 16-bit, fixed-point DSPs for cost-sensitive applications like the low-power residential microgrids. The performance of the proposed resonant controller is evaluated using a single-phase inverter that can be part of a grid-connected Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS).

articleTitle: Space Vector PWM-DTC in an application for crude oil extraction in Canadian version
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper presents a study of the behavior of an induction motor drive with Space Vector PWM-DTC algorithm, in a simulation for a crude oil extraction application, which requires robust torque sets, specific to complete extraction strokes, on a wide range of operating speed variations. The SV-DTC variant drops the hysteresis regulators of classical DTC technique in favor of two PI regulators, thus managing a better decoupling of the mechanical phenomena from the magnetic ones of the machine, which will be highlighted by the results obtained from the simulations. It has been proposed as novelty an extension of the simulation scheme to obtain the values of the energy losses of the electric drive, losses that could be recovered by the owner of the field oil equipment, because on certain portions the electric machine works in the generator mode.

articleTitle: Psycho-Pedagogical Aspects Concerning The Development of the Students’ Metacognitive Competeces
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Metacognition is closely related to type reflective thinking, thinking about processes, thinking about thinking. Application of metacognition in learning requires constant awareness of how we learn, the methods we use and the results they produce and estimate the effort required achieving a cognitive acquisition. This article presents the results of the focus-group applied on 12 university teaching staff. The focus-group aimed to reveal the participants' opinions, attitudes, and beliefs about the development of the students' metacognitive competences. In order to facilitate student learning, the participant teachers mentioned that will be given a special seminar presentation of memory techniques artificial elements of hygiene and ergonomics of intellectual work, the manner of the essay or offer further explanations on how to acquire concepts, showing concern for structuring material in clear, coherent logic. It emphasized the need to focus the student's positive first contact with a subject to reduce fear of new or failure. Presentation discipline of study and workload in attractive, interesting learning make the effort to be optimally dosed by students. During the educational activities, the professionals involved in the focus group promote high pedagogical qualities such as enthusiasm for the profession, confidence in students and their potential, active learning, humanism, cooperation and participation.

articleTitle: Signal propagation analysis for vehicle communications through tunnels
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Vehicular communications represent the backbone of future transport, as the direction towards autonomous vehicles is obvious and the need for vehicles to be aware of their environment through data exchange with other traffic participants and/or infrastructure equipment is also clear. There are several signal propagation phenomena that makes the data transfer difficult, even in the absence of other communications on the same channel or frequency band. These occur in cities (due to building reflection, penetration etc.), but also outside of cities (in tunnels). In this article, we will overview the most important signal propagation issues and we'll concentrate on signal propagation in tunnels, considering that this is the main problem outside the cities. Besides the theoretical aspects that will be discussed, we have performed a series of simulations using Matlab environment.

articleTitle: A comparative scientometric study of ECAI conference series
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: ECAI conference series proves to be instrumental in promoting the University of Pitesti and, in general, the Romanian universities on the international stage. This viewpoint is supported by the number of proceedings papers in conferences related to electronics, to computer science, and to A.I., as reflected in the database Word of Science (WOS). Because of ECAI, the University of Pitesti ranks among the first 10 universities in the world, based on the above criteria (number of conference papers in WOS, in conferences with the above specified keywords in the title). The organizers of the ECAI conference series and all the contributors in this conference series have achieved a notable success on the international stage.

articleTitle: Startegies for Achieving Moral-Civic Education in Primary Education
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In the context of game, lessons and extracurricular activities, where interpersonal and group relationships are the main relationship ways, the first characteristic features that will become condensed into the small school's behavior begin to form. The requirements expressed by the adult educator must be in accordance with the way the child can meet these requirements: the contradiction between the child's wishes and broad aspirations and the limited possibilities of satisfying them could lead either to positive characteristics and to a civilized behavior or disorderly conduct to negative characterizing features. If it is desired to involve pupils in the realization of moral and aesthetic values then it is necessary to organize the lessons the civic education/personal development, using appropriate methods and means, especially the explanatory reading method.

articleTitle: Methods of Interdisciplinarity Approach to Literary Content to Achieve Moral-Civic Education in Primary School
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Through the use and adequate interdisciplinary integration in school activities of the most effective methods of moral education, one can reach the formation of moral values corroborated with the capitalization of the literary texts in the lessons of Romanian language and literature. By addressing the literary text from the axiological point of view in the Romanian language and the civic education in the primary cycle, in accordance with the objectives and content of the training and with the psychological profile of the children's age, the roles within the group can be influenced, and through them moral and aesthetic formation of children also. The study of the Romanian language has a special significance in the formation of the students, ensuring their intellectual evolution, the appropriate training in the other disciplines and their integration into the social life.

articleTitle: Managing conflict situations within the school system organisation
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Organisational practice shows that the conflicted situations are used as important strategies for obtaining a better result as detrimental to the progress of others. As a consequence, the conflict must be regarded as an element of organisational life, precisely because there are differences between attitudes, purposes, ways of action or to a situation within the leadership process. Successful management practice requires from the very beginning the identification of conflicting sources as well as the factors that favour their orientation in the sense of the reduction of managerial performance. The conflict can be a catalyst of change, so it may force organisations to re-examine their goals and readjust their priorities. This study highlights the importance of optimal conflict resolution within the school organization to ensure a favourable climate for the development of the educational-educational process at high standards.

articleTitle: Theoretical efficiency analysis of a buck-boost converter for wide voltage range operation
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper is analyzing the efficiency and power losses distribution on the bidirectional buck-boost topology, commonly used in renewable energy and automotive applications. For these applications the converter can be developed with constant output voltage considering that the input voltage is variable in a defined range, while in future smart grids applications the need for output wide voltage range converter could become a necessity. Based on a PSIM model and simulation approach, the study is analyzing the performances of the topology considering that both the input and output voltages can evolve in wide ranges.

articleTitle: Improving the Quality of Web Applications Through Targeted Usability Enhancements
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In the competitive software industry, companies are starting to see the advantage of investing in user-oriented, as opposed to technology-oriented, products in order to attract or preserve their users. A piece of software might function exactly as specified in the requirements, but it may not be fit for use. This article is for product managers, developers and quality assurance engineers alike, as well as all those united by a fervent desire to improve the quality of their software. Qualitative and quantitative user experience metrics may be difficult to obtain without significant investment, but an initial redesign of a software product has been proven to more than double its usability, provided it was performed by analyzing the input of a user-centric assessment.

articleTitle: Web platform for integration of transcoding in AWS cloud domain with 3d Web graphics
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In recent years, cloud transcoding has evolved rapidly and gaining great popularity due to new possibilities for the content distribution. The advance of JavaScript browser engine has permitted the inclusion of 3D graphics effects in Web pages. We propose a web platform which allows the user to combine a 3D graphics effects with video contents. For video encoding and delivery, the Amazon AWS cloud platform is used.

articleTitle: Modeling an ANN-based control for optimal operation of PEMFC systems
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In the field of the proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs), the main objectives of a control strategy are to optimize the electrochemical reactions in the reaction subsystem in order to increase the fuel economy and energy efficiency, as well as ensure the load demand under a dynamic load profile and variable available power from renewable energy sources (RESs). Among others, the Global Extremum Seeking (GES) optimization technique has shown its capability to deal with these requirements. In this paper a classical implementation of a GES controller is analyzed and an artificial neural network (ANN) based implementation is obtained, showing that the approximation is accurate.

articleTitle: New design and improved performance for smoke detector
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Most of the photoelectric smoke detectors use a single LED that emits at a single narrow wavelength band to illuminate the smoke chamber. Consequently, a single light detector is arranged so that light from the LED is detected only when it is scattered out of its direct path due to the presence of smoke or some other aerosol. Due to the use of a single wavelength band, a system cannot very well practically distinguish between smoke due to an unwanted fire and aerosols generated by harmless activities such as cooking and bathing. Also is unable to distinguish between light scattered from smoke (or aerosol) and light originating from the external environment. A “labyrinth” exclude ambient light but slows the admittance of air and smoke into the smoke chamber, thus increasing the time needed for the smoke detector to react to some types of fires.

articleTitle: Specific Problems of the Propylene-Propane Distillation Column Control with Heat Pump
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper focuses on the study of specific problems of the propylene-propane binary distillation column control with heat pump. The first part of the paper demonstrates the opportunity to use a heat pump for an investigated propane-propylene distillation column. Starting from the importance of the heat pump, in the second part of the paper it is presented the modeling and simulation of the compressor with the heat pump. In the final part, two control solutions based on a control structure that is well studied in literature are proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of driver behaviour's influence in urban traffic flows
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Urban traffic is generally getting more congested every passing year. Failure to implement sustainable measures in many cities leads to increased congestion and huge delays, causing drivers' nervousness and tendency to disobey traffic rules. This may have an influence on general traffic, as, for example, a car that force the entrance in a junction may cause other vehicles to be in the impossibility of continuing their travel, even when having priority of passage. In this article the behaviour of drivers is analysed, while estimating the probability of aggressive behaviour occurrence in different scenarios. Measurements have been made in the city of Bucharest, both in signalized and unsignalized road junctions, during peak hours or in light traffic, to be able to compare different patterns and estimate the probability of occurrence.

articleTitle: A Computer Tool for Statistical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In this paper, I present a computer tool specially designed to be applied for the statistical analysis of data collected in the business field, for quality control. Companies that use information technology have recorded data that, properly treated, give them an advantage over other companies. It has been demonstrated over time that the success of the business analysis depends on the quality of data and the availability of well-trained analysts who have a very good understanding of both information technology and business. An application to analyze the economic evolution of a company was designed and tested. The analytical and graphic approach of those features that highlight the various aspects relevant to conducting in optimal conditions the company activity have been considered in the design of the application. The programming language chosen for the application implementation was C#, part of Visual Studio. The experimental data set was stored in a database using Excel spreadsheets, form Microsoft Office.

articleTitle: Iris recognition using SIFT descriptors with different distance measures
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Experiments on iris recognition using Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) features and several distance measures we defined are presented. Two well-known iris databases, UBIRIS and UPOL, were used as primary data. From unsegmented images of UPOL database we derived other two test datasets: one using manually segmented images and another one using automatic segmented images. The distance measures defined using SIFT feature were applied for iris recognition using as input the four datasets: UBIRIS, UPOL and those two derived from UPOL. The experiments results revealed that the tested methods can be used as a simple, fast and very efficient filter, whose output can be then processed by more sophisticated methods.

articleTitle: Mobile application for a smart city
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In the last few years the number of smart city projects increased drastically and almost all countries have at least one smart city or started implementing a smart city architecture. This paper's purpose is highlighting the functionality of our smart city mobile application, it's features and the way it can influence our lives and the way we interact with the world around us in everyday activities. The system we are describing can monitor and give the end user viewing access to important information about the city he / she lives in. It can also send alerts in the form of push notifications, SMS messages or email about public interest information, new laws, shops, emergencies, natural disasters or any relevant information for the public. Using this application, the public can also send useful feedback to the authorities about broken stuff existing in the city, potholes, accidents, etc., while also using the mobile devices geolocation feature to indicate the specified location's problem The application can also be used to view information about the users, home, as electric consumption, temperature in different rooms, water quality, outside weather, security camera feed, security alarm state, etc. The users can also interact with the application and send commands to his / her smart home, like starting or stopping the central heating, starting or stopping different home appliances.

articleTitle: Sentiment analysis for the tweets that contain the word “earthquake”
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The social networks represent modern means of conveying information and states. The accurate access to the messages and states in the shortest period of time might be very useful in case this contributes to reducing the risk of producing destructive events. In case of earthquakes, it is highly important to be aware of the people's state in order to rapidly provide help. There are multiple information methods used to identify the sentiment and the human opinion, but the results should be vigilantly managed. The latter are related to the real existing circumstances that might be determined by the environmental factors. The present study aims to identify the people's states when they are posting a short message on Twitter, immediately after a natural event, such as an earthquake. Knowing the opinion of those people who were in a calamity-earthquake situation, and also knowing the sentiment analysis, a contribution to the quantification of the reaction regarding these events that they were exposed to might be supplied.

articleTitle: A PKCS#11 Driver for Cryptography in the Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: During the last years several server-side/cloud signatures solutions have been proposed and implemented. Because no standards exist yet in this field, each such solution exposes its own API for performing keys/certificates management and cryptographic operations. This means that a client application wanting to implement the remote signing process, has to do so separately for each of the solutions it needs to support. This paper proposed a solution to this problem that would also assure interoperability with the local signing applications: the use of PKCS#11 (Public Key Cryptography Standards) drivers for performing server-side/cloud signatures. Just as in the case of smart cards, if each server-side signatures provider would implement a PKCS#11 driver for their solution, would allow any client working with this standard to make use of their functionalities without any change in the source code. A proof of concept has been implemented.

articleTitle: Challenges in Automotive Security
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The modern cars are becoming more and more complex, allowing us to connect our phone to graphical interfaces of the car or have the vehicle system directly connected to external networks. These transformations include major advantages in efficiency, comfort and safety mechanisms, but the systems developed in a car are becoming targets for cyber security attacks. The software level in the automotive industry is increasing so the systems are becoming vulnerable to threats from the IT world. In this paper we present the entry points, the weaknesses in vehicle systems and emerging threats.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Framework for a Social Network Application
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper describes an efficient way to create a social network web application where worldwide users can create their profile, post statuses, photos, comment on them, make friends, talk with each other and many more. The first step was to decide what technology is best suited for this kind of application, what structure it must have to allow further implementation and last but not least, how the interface will look to attract more customers. Also it must be easy to use, basically making the experience better. The next step was to identify the needs of the population, which will help in better understanding the psychological factors that affect them as customer and what you can do to get their attention. The application has been implemented in PHP programming language and uses JavaScript AJAX calls to improve the user experience and application flow overall.

articleTitle: RSSI Based Localization of Bluetooth Devices Using Trilateration: An Improved Method for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The instantaneous and spatial localization for visually impaired people in dynamically changing environments with unexpected hazards and obstacles, is the most demanding and challenging issue faced by the navigation systems today. Although time difference of arrival (TDOA), time of arrival (TOA) and received signal strength (RSS) have been used in literature multiple times for positioning, but narrow band signals such as Bluetooth cannot efficiently utilize TDOA or TOA. Received signal strength indicator (RSSI), to measure RSS, has been found to be more suitable in this case. It has been found that the estimations using RSSI can be improved significantly by improving the existing methodologies related to RSSI. Therefore, the current paper focuses on proposing an improved method using trilateration for localization of Bluetooth devices for visually impaired people. To validate the method, class 2 Bluetooth devices were used along with the development of a software. Experiments were then conducted to obtain surface plots that showed the signal interferences and other environmental effects. Finally, the results obtained were discussed.

articleTitle: A new method for the generation of test words in a typing learning program
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Typing to a computer has become a very important skill. The most used method of typing is typing blindly using all ten fingers, as it increases the typing speed and it also reduces neck and shoulder pain. There are many typing learning software programs available on Internet, either free or not. In this paper it is presented a method for selecting the words that are presented in a typing tutor software program. The words are selected taking into account the fingers that are used to write them. The typing tutor is served with different words that are written using the same fingers. Using a coding scheme, each word will have a formula that results from the fingers used to write the word on the keyboard. Using a modified binary search algorithm, all the words that are written using same fingers, can be presented to the typing tutor application.

articleTitle: Extracurricular Activities for Fostering Language and Literature in Primary School
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Extracurricular activities are generally carried out collectively, being created and organized on the principle of free consent, according to the specific norms of each activity, avoiding overloading the students. When recruiting and engaging students in such activities we have to take into account their age specifics, individual interests and preferences. These are complementary activities with great educational potential. They bring the new, the intellectual and emotional surprise, combine usefulness with pleasure, have a preponderantly recreational, respond to the current needs of integration into society. They are forms of activity that avoid monotony, boredom and fatigue, stimulate the creativity, the spirit of cooperation and initiative of the children and enhance the fun-recreational skills. The present paper will look at a range of extracurricular activities to foster students' knowledge of language and literature at primary school level and gives detail on how to organize such activities.

articleTitle: Words Diffusion an Analysis of across Facebook Pages in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Facebook Pages in Thailand have become prominent and very well-known in online media, business, and news broadcasting. Facebook pages seem to have become importantly technological tools which can provide methods and frameworks for identifying trending words and analyzing their trends and flows. The results demonstrated that incorporating reaction factor when weighting importance of words found in messages posted in different period of time and domains can help identify flows of trendy words.

articleTitle: Mining Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper focuses on identifying patterns in medical data that can bring economic advantage to medical facilities. The main objective is to determine which algorithm fits best on a medical data set in order to determine how likely a patient will return for a new consult. In order to achieve that a medical data set was used to evaluate the accuracy of each algorithm and what it could predict. The proposed software prototype is uses the data mining algorithm in order to offer real time insights to clinic employees about patients. Based on this information, clinic employees can offer vouchers in order to tempt patients into choosing the clinic again for their next consult. Using data mining techniques to gain economic advantage might play a decisive role in company's fight supremacy.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic PDE-based Additive Gaussian Noise Removal Solution combining Second and Fourth order Diffusions
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: A hybrid nonlinear PDE-based denoising framework is proposed in this paper. The considered image restoration algorithm is based on a well-posed hyperbolic differential model that combines second-order to fourth-order diffusions. A consistent finite difference method-based numerical approximation algorithm is then constructed for solving this hyperbolic diffusion-based model. Our successful image restoration tests that show the effectiveness of the proposed method are also discussed.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between Pedagogy - Education Policy - Education Reform. A Historical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: From a historical perspective, we can identify the stages of pedagogy evolution in the premodern, modern and contemporary age. The education reform suggests a qualitative change, supported at the level of education policy, to be elaborated on the basis of a pedagogical conception validated by the community. At the normative and axiological level, the education reform is properly designed, organized and conducted if it is based on a thoroughly developed education policy, in line with the concepts and principles of pedagogy, as a science specializing in the study of education.

articleTitle: Detecting Forged Images a Robust Java Implementation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Image manipulation represents a true “art”, which takes into account the images with a lot of their properties. There are many ways a digital photo can be manipulated, so the forger can use one or more combinations of these in order to make their detection more difficult. On the other hand, only one detection technique is specific to a single image manipulation. For instance, a duplication detection method is based on an existing correlation between the segment of the original image and the copied image. This paper presents a robust Java implementation of an algorithm detecting such a Copy-Move forged pictures.

articleTitle: Enabling a Multi-Level Users Management Policy in Cloud of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In computing, one of the rapidly growing technologies is cloud computing, which comes with great benefits, as well as with some drawbacks. One of the issues examined in the present paper is the secure clients' location sharing method, from the perspective of data integrity and authenticity. These are issues associated with sharing of data in cloud-based locations. The first aspect to analyze is the access mechanism, which raises security issues if it is not secured enough for sensitive data. Data stored in cloud (big data) is often accessed by third party, which increases the exposure to attacks. The privacy violation risks thus become higher. Cloud-stored data usually is processed or used by third party. Data owners (clients) must ensure information privacy of the stored or processed data. The solution proposed in this paper for cloud data management and classification is a schema organized on multiple levels and based on policy in order to increase reliability of cloud computing in terms of confidentiality of sensitive data. The paper is based on a solid security policy structure which follow the specifications and abilities. The algorithm presented in the paper efficiently provides data accuracy and validity with the employment and management of the outlined policies, complying to cloud customers' specifications and cloud providers' possibilities.

articleTitle: Human being approached as an adaptive self-regulated system
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Evaluating the human being from control systems engineering perspective is useful for both understanding the mechanism of self-regulation as the fundament of human life preservation and development of specific methods in limiting interactions that can lead to irreversible damage in the homeostatic regulation process. This approach is useful for physicians, engineers and sociologists, especially in the development of specific medical equipment and social strategies for preventing diseases and improving life quality.

articleTitle: Prediction of Post likes Using Clustering and Regression Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This research presented the result of comparative between like prediction that used clustering technique and like prediction that didn't use clustering technique to predict likes on Facebook. We collected data who clicked like button on Fanpage post. We analyzed likes of Fanpage several key factors before prediction. We using regression analysis to calculate correlation of each datasets and pick up one which is better to create model by our approach. And show the result of both approaches between clustering and non-clustering.

articleTitle: The implementation of a software system for detecting a pattern in an ambient light sensor data stream
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Ambient light sensors are present in many mid and top tier smart devices in order to give to the user good contrast and color representation. As newer sensors get better resolution it is possible to clearly identify patterns in the light sensor data stream originating from light sources that the user is interacting with. This paper presents the implementation of the software components for a system that receives the ambient light sensor data from a mobile Android Smartphone, saves it to a database and analyses it in order to detect a reference pattern. The pattern is produced by a video stream that is rendered by a display.

articleTitle: Eye Tracking based Real- Time Non-Interfering Driver Fatigue Detection System
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Driver fatigue, cause fatal road accidents, and is a major socio-economic concern. The human body exhibits signs of fatigue, which can provide us with the information needed for fatigue detection. This study presents to develop an eye tracking based real time noninterfering driver fatigue detection system. In the proposed method Haar-like features based cascade classifiers are utilized to detect the face and eyes of the driver, skin colour based segmentation is used to calculate eye openness and Support Vector Machine (SVM) to deduce the eyes state as fatigued or non-fatigued.

articleTitle: Influence of Outliers on Transformer Power Losses Estimation Using a Statistical Based Data Mining Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Distribution network operators (DNOs) are alarmed for fluctuating behavior of power consumption in the process of decision-making. In the Smart Meters data, outliers can occur from recordings irregularity, undiscovered power demand, illegal user's connection, inadequately installed devices etc. The paper presents an original data mining based approach that acquires the basic concept of knowledge discovery on databases (KDD), focused to identification of outliers recorded by Smart Meters. This information was the input data for power losses estimation in power transformers. In order to validate the proposed approach, a real database with 300 rural substation was considered. By applying the proposed methodology the DNOs know the real technical losses and also a proper operation and planning of actually “smart” networks can be applied.

articleTitle: Modelling the users' profiles based on their behaviour in social applications
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The Internet today also facilitates interactions between people at great distances and interactions between users and software systems in other parts of the globe. The major issue is the automatic identification of the person involved in the interaction and the validation that the person carrying out certain activities through the software system, is the legal person and not an unauthorized person. This material aims to conduct a report/study of the behavioural and user interaction characteristics in various social applications, as well as to establish methods for determining the user's profile at the level of social applications based on their existing behaviour.

articleTitle: Increasing the reliability of an industrial cold production system using Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Starting from the design phase of a system to its daily use, the reliability of the equipment is the most important feature of the assembly. One of the methods of defect analysis is Fault Tree Analysis (FTA). This method consists of constructing a logical schema of failure of the components of the analyzed system. In this paper we will present the analysis carried out using the FTA, at Renault - central Titu, for an artificial cold plant, a plant that serves a solar radiation simulation bench at different temperatures. This analysis was carried out after a major fault in the refrigeration plant (burning the electric motor from one of the compressors) in March 2016. The analysis was performed to define the probability of recurrence of the fault with the purpose of modifying the preventive maintenance plan and internal standardization of the verification and prevention procedure for both the facility and other similar installations.

articleTitle: Considerations on interference between FSO systems
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: FSO systems benefit from multi-Gbps communication speed and ease of installation and exploitation. If two or more FSO transceivers operate in the immediate vicinity, then there is the possibility of optical interference between systems that result in performance lowering. This paper attempts to quantify these performance losses by presenting some practical, concrete situations. It also analyzes the decrease in performance due to background and solar radiation, as well as the measures that can be taken for total or partial annihilation.

articleTitle: Considerations on the Numerical Modeling of the Induction Heating Process Using the Elta and Flux 2D Software
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This study presents, based on our research of literature in the field, the main aspects regarding the induction heating process using specific equipment, as well as the current trends in the assisted design of these equipment. In addition, the study also presents the results of simulating the process of annealing a knife made of OLC45 material, using the commercial software ELTA and FLUX 2D. Finally, we present the results obtained for a series of simulations performed with the help of the two software mentioned above.

articleTitle: LED performance analysis under various current waveforms
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper is addressing an important factor in LED performance, which is the behavior of these devices under various current waveforms, mainly rectangular and triangular types. More, the study is a practical recognition on how LED devices can perform at different switching periods with low frequency ripples in the range of 0 to 100%. The practical measurements are made on three types of LEDs, showing their performance under the same general test conditions.

articleTitle: Some effects of oral assessment applied to a literature course for English language teaching students: A case study
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This study refers to some positive and negative effects of oral assessment applied to a literature course. The experiment was conducted in a north Cyprus university English language teaching (ELT) department, during the spring semester of the 2016-2017 academic year. The data were collected from the ELT students taking the Survey to English Literature course (SELC) during the spring semester of the 2016-2017 academic year, who were asked to fill in an open ended questionnaire about the intervention, and semi structured interviews conducted with the co-examiners. In the ELT department under discussion, almost all the exams are written, and the students do not have too many opportunities to speak during the courses or during their mid-term exam. The results show the benefits and drawbacks of implementing oral examinations to assess students' literature knowledge.

Author Keywords: Survey of English Literature course assessment procedure

articleTitle: Optimizing and Modeling the drying process of the Natural Gas through the Taguchi method
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The aim of this study is to highlight the optimization method of the drying process of natural gas, using the Taguchi method. The natural gas undergoes several stages from its extraction until reaching its end consumer. As the natural gas contains several impurities and a certain quantity of water and vapors, the drying process is very important to obtain a product of high quality. Gas dehydration can be obtained through several methods, the method presented here being the absorption method - by use of a drying station with triglycol. This method is considered to be the most convenient one taking into account the obtained results. Nevertheless, cost reducing is the main objective for companies. Therefore it has been observed that the costs can be reduced by optimizing the fundamental parameters of a drying station with triglycol. The present work is a first experiment that allows memorizing an optimal configuration necessary for the functional parameters in order for the drying station with triglycol to obtain a value as close as possible to the due point, a value that has been forecasted in the technical agreement as to reduce the technological consumptions and the costs. The relationship between the main parameters in a drying station, their interaction and the values considered optimal in attaining the drying station purposes have been established.

Author Keywords: process of drying the natural gas

articleTitle: Designing and testing by virtual methods of an amplitude corrector circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper presents the method of designing a correction circuit of amplitude, followed by virtual testing, based on the use of two engineering programming environments: Orcad and Labview. The right design and testing of the amplitude correction circuit enables the obtaining of the attenuation-frequency characteristics prescribed.

articleTitle: Open source hardware and software V2V emergency braking warning application
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Inter-vehicular communications is one of the main support technologies for the future autonomous cars. Safety applications shall greatly benefit from this technology. To this end, this paper presents an open source inter-vehicular communication system and the design of a safety application, i.e., emergency braking warning.

articleTitle: Design and implement of independent position confirming and correcting system
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The position confirming and correcting systems are being designed and built more and more in industries like automotive in assembly lines, flexible assembly lines using automation control for moving and position control systems, packaging systems, warehouse systems, robotic arms, environments difficult or not efficient for a human operator to work in.

articleTitle: Semi-Supervized Hyperspectral Image Classification using Virtually Labeled Training Data based on the Improved Gaussian Mixture Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper presents a semi-supervised approach for classifying hyperspectral remote sensing imagery using an improved clustering for training data selection. This approach is a development and an adaptation for hyperspectral imagery of the recent semi-supervised classification method proposed by the same authors for multispectral images. The present model follows the below steps: (a) dimensionality reduction of the hyperspectral pixels by Principal Component Analysis (PCA); (b) clustering in the low-dimensional space obtained after PCA processing using the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) with expectation-maximization (EM), which includes a K-means initialization phase; (c) selection, according to pixels' virtual labels given by clustering, of the training set; (d) inclusion in the training set of “M” pixels per class with genuine labels; (e) training of a semi-supervised SVM classifier (S3VM); (f) S3VM classification. For experiments, we have used the Pavia University hyperspectral image dataset. The experimental results have shown a significant performance improvement of the proposed semi-supervised classifier compared to the supervised SVM.

articleTitle: THE VALORIFICATION OF STUDENTS COMPETENCES LEARNED IN NONFORMAL AND INFORMAL ENVIRONMENT
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In a knowledge society, where education continually redefines its meanings, the need to assess and recognize the learner's competences is a complex task, given the diversity of competency formation paths, and taking into account the skills acquired in non-formal and informal environments. A large number of countries and organizations are busy defining a formal framework for validating the non-formal and informal learning experiences and their certification. The specialty studies highlight the benefits offered by the non-formal education, which does not necessitates the participation of students and whose activities take place outside of school; the informal environment also brings varied learning opportunities to learners' skills and is fully adapted to the needs and interests of learners throughout their lifelong learning. The study is based on a brief analysis of school curricula for primary education, highlighting the relevant presence of non-formal and informal elements in the curriculum: through specialized sites - Animal Planet, Discovery, National Geographic; informal communication elements specific to social networks; extracurricular activities - meetings with cultural personalities, visits and thematic excursions, etc. The conclusions of the study are a possible framework for capitalizing the competences acquired by the students in the non-formal and informal environment in a formal/school context.

articleTitle: Digitally migration concept for railway failsafe protection circuit
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: There are well known the railway protection pulse circuits, the most used solution for train segment access protection. One of the most common problem of the railway infrastructure administrator's is the heterogeneous specific of the installations, each segment and/or generation being equipped with different solution, corresponding to the technology generation, parts performances, available energy source and so on. The common characteristics of all the systems is that it uses power injectors over tracks, from continuously voltage to alternate pulses and even codes. The paper proposes to redesign the track code transmitter, in order to cover most of the existing in-rail systems with only one programmable device, fail-safe, capable to ensure all kind of necessary codes according to existing but also predicted infrastructure: continuous pulse, encoded pulse, audio-signals (such as the Subway uses) and other. A deeply analysis regarding reliability solution is also provided.

articleTitle: Functionally Graded Virtual Robogami: A Geometry Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Functional gradient takes a specific position in various fields of research. Functionally graded materials (FGM) are highly respected regarding their nonconstant, FG certain property. A virtual geometrical model of a heaven-and-hell-origami-like object is known from previous research. Its parts exhibit a FG shape, and, originally, they are not planar elements. An objective of this paper is to present a given origami-like object from two aspects: a) reconfigurability of the object and b) modular origami-like structure, mori, created by composing several mentioned origami-like objects. All activities are done by using parametric equations of the relevant components as well as via those linear transformations, which conserve shape and size of elements and in such a way they correspond to robotic motions, known at the current level of knowledge. The findings based on geometrical “wings” and “shackles” - possibilities and limitations - are stated. Potential applications, educational use as well as Easter egg (“secret” feature) are sketched.

articleTitle: Intelligent Tools and Methods in Power Delivery Quality and Efficiency Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper proposes to use intelligent methods to study the quality and efficiency for a power delivery system supplying the consumers in a residential area. An original study proposed in this paper will take in account professional computer design environment like Edsa Paladin for providing technical solutions to save power, reducing the delivery losses by implementing power factor correction for the medium voltage area. Together with the efficiency also the quality of the delivered power is analyzed, before the factor correction solutions implementation. The solutions follow the goal to minimize the total power losses on the medium voltage network analyzed and to maximize the quality of the delivered power. On this purpose we use the real data base given by the local power delivery system supervisor.

articleTitle: Digital Implementation of Nonlinear Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The present contribution aims at comparing the behavior of discrete-time chaotic generators, used in encryption and other communication security structures of biomedical signals. The two types of analyzed systems are a digital filter with nonlinear behavior due to overflow and a discrete system based on an analog prototype, designed by direct sampling. Programing implementation performance of the chaotic generators, on microcontroller systems, is finally compared to high precision simulations of the state equations models.

articleTitle: The importance of PLC in the predictive maintenance of electronic equipment
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to highlight the importance of the programmable logic controllers in the predictive maintenance. The PLC-based control system concept and the types of equipment with software for maintenance are presented. A model of the software for maintenance of diverse electronic equipment based on case studies is analyzed in the last part of this paper.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of acoustic field in standing wave thermoacoustic engine with different stack lengths
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper deals with a CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) simulation of standing wave thermoacoustic engine composed of tube (resonator) and stack placed between two heat exchangers. Theoretical models are developed based on coupled compressible Navier-Stokes and heat transfer equations that govern the working gas. The study is performed to investigate the influence of stack length on the acoustic wave. The thermoacoustic effect has been firstly validated using numerical results obtained by using Ansys fluent in order to be used in the present investigation. It is found that the variation of stack length not only influences the acoustic pressure and frequency of the system, but also affects the acoustic field along the tube.

articleTitle: Modeling Mpls Routers By Petri's Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: MPLS addresses large networks; it is difficult to achieve a realistic model in the short term. This is why we plan to simulate different approaches. Our study is thus concretized by the development of models able to bring solutions to the problems of evaluation of the performances and improvement of the quality of the services of the networks MPLS. This paper presents the modeling of MPLS routers by colored Petri nets. Petri networks represent a mathematical tool, health in the field of modeling and verification systems; in addition to their analytical strength it provides a simple graphical representation which helps the modeling of complex systems.

articleTitle: Preventive Maintenance of the Railway Infrastructure employing Robotized Platform and Virtual Instrumentation
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Usually, a railway interlocking system gathers information from its insulated sections, also known as track circuits. Each section is consisting of a distinct electrical circuit that provides vital information regarding rolling stock position and presence. The track circuit is a critically safe component, and even in the case of a failure it must ensure that trains do not collide. Thus, the maintenance of these functional blocks is of a major importance in the automation process. If the maintenance procedures are implemented correctly and adequately the failures are potentially eliminated, or at least their frequency reduced, thus improving the safety and reducing maintenance costs. This paper presents an innovative solution to optimize the railway infrastructure maintenance operations in terms of time, need of human operators and energy consumption. A robotized, semi-automatic mobile platform is employed for different safety parameters measurement. Collected data can be either stored onboard or transmitted via a non-dedicated short-range communications technology to a control point, operated by maintenance engineers. As the track circuit is a vital component of the railway safety signaling systems this remote preventive tool can contribute significantly to a maximum level of efficiency of the maintenance policy for every railway administration. The architecture of the system, a virtual instrumentation algorithm and mathematical models are presented in the paper, along with conclusions and recommendations.

articleTitle: Learning Algorithms for Single Image Deraining
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Three deep learning based algorithms are compared in terms of standard figures of merit and visual quality for single image deraining. The comparative analysis additionally considers several classic approaches based on redundant representations or Gaussian Mixture Models. Experimental results are reported for both synthetic and real images, revealing higher quality of the neural based approaches.

articleTitle: Voltage Difference Transconductance Amplifier based Voltage Mode Band Pass Filter with constant Q-Factor
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper, realizes a new band pass filter (BPF) circuit based on two Voltage Differencing Transconductance Amplifiers (VDTAs). The devised circuit uses two capacitors without using a resistor. It makes an easy way for the fabrication of ICs in VLSI design. It operates in voltage-mode. The proposed circuit is enforced in a gpdk 180 nm CMOS process using a Cadence Virtuoso tool. Moreover, the proposed Band Pass Filter circuit operated at low voltage i.e., ±0.9 V, avails bias current of 150 μA and dissipates 0.54 mW power. The transconductance value of this element is electronically tunable/controllable with the bias currents.

articleTitle: Synchronous Current Switching Technique for Adjusting the CMOS Ring Oscillator Duty Cycle
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The present work proposes a low cost, synchronous current switching technique for adjusting a 60MHz, medium frequency, oscillator duty cycle. Current switching is necessary due to the use of both charge and discharge delays of the oscillator topology. Added circuitry consists on trimmable current mirrors and synchronizing circuitry. Main goal is not to affect the functionality of the system, nor initial frequency or duty cycle variation. The circuit is designed using sub micrometer technologies, for a supply voltage range between 1.6V and 2V.

articleTitle: Multi-band Response Antenna Bio-inspired from Biological Neuron Morphology
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The electromagnetic field recorded outside neurons, such as the scalp, is the result of different ions moving from synapses to soma and further to terminal buttons. This phenomenon can be displaced from low frequency in the microwave field using the corresponding changes of space and time, and the dendritic tree or axons could be modeled as the transmitting or receiving antenna. A compact microstrip antenna modeling the topology of biological neurons is investigated in this paper by using the spatial configuration given into the NeuroMorpho.org data base. This is a continuation of some previous research of authors and is focused on the influence of partial changes of dendritic tree segments, highlighted by changing characteristics of resonance and radiation in free space. The morphometric structures have been translated in the field of microwaves using microstrip line networks. The comparative modeling and simulation results regarding to multi-band response obtained by solving Maxwell's numerical equations in frequency domain for initial geometric configuration and when one of the dendritic tree branches is functional affected are presented in this paper. This kind of antenna is a natural correspondence of the fractal antennas described in the literature for their advantages regarding small sizes and multi-band response.

articleTitle: Virtual tool for the determination of time zone difference
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In the present paper, the author proposes the design and implementation of a virtual tool, using the Labview graphical programming environment, in order to determine the time difference between any two countries in the world.

articleTitle: The role of pedagogical practice in teaching skills training
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Pedagogical practice plays a particularly important role in the formation of future teachers because it trains them for the didactic career through a series of activities that take place in school units, depending on the specialization. The school institutions in which these activities take place are selected by the authorities in the field according to certain criteria. Students who want to become teachers have the option to register for this course at the beginning of university studies and must participate in all the courses in this module. Courses take place during the three years of university studies, being arranged in a balanced manner. The pedagogical practice takes place in the 3rd year of university studies, during 2 semesters, and is structured in the form of assistant hours, teaching hours, the final form of evaluation of the practical students being the colloquium. The coordinator practice has an important role to play with the mentor teacher in developing students' teaching abilities.

articleTitle: Personalized Mio-electrical Monitoring System Based on ADS1298 and MIM Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper depicts a versatile solution for noninvasive electrophysiological signals recording, by a specialized ADS1298 bio-medical platform, equiped with signal acquisition on laptop. The novelty degree of this paper comes from a new acquisition platform, specialized in bio-electrical signal cropping, besides to some Metal-Insulator-Metal - MIM capacitive electrodes, specially fabricated for this purpose. The capacitive electrodes avoid the disadvantage of high series resistance, encountered to metallic electrodes and are more sensitive to variable biosignal that can overlap. The cropped electrical signals at skin level are converted into a digital format as a vector data and then stored and post-processed by optimal computing resources. This paper presents the final stage of a personalized biomedical signal system for many myo-electrical scopes. Therefore, some tests on subjects are available.

articleTitle: Teaching System for Pneumatic Actuations
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper presents how teaching pneumatic equipment can be used in the educational process. The paper is structured in three parts. In the first part are investigated the elements that are used in the study of pneumatic automatic systems: products of the profile companies, specific publications, related disciplines. The second part is dedicated to the presentation of educational equipment produced by ASTI Automation Bucharest. The last part presents an example of the design elements necessary for the realization of a pneumatic automatic system: designing and testing the system structure and PLC programming for a didactic application.

articleTitle: Assessing Level of Resilience Using Attack Graphs
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Cyber-Physical-Systems are subject to cyber-attacks due to existing vulnerabilities in the various components constituting them. System Resiliency is concerned with the extent the system is able to bounce back to a normal state under attacks. In this paper, two communication Networks are analyzed, formally described, and modeled using Architecture Analysis & Design Language (AADL), identifying their architecture, connections, vulnerabilities, resources, possible attack instances as well as their pre-and post-conditions. The generated network models are then verified against a security property using JKind model checker integrated tool. The union of the generated attack sequences/scenarios resulting in overall network compromise (given by its loss of stability) is the Attack graph. The generated Attack graph is visualized graphically using Unity software, and then used to assess the worst Level of Resilience for both networks.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm for passive source localization
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper proposes and evaluates by numerical simulation a hybrid algorithm that combines global and local optimizations for the problem of localizing an unknown source. Coherent observations of the signal at distributed sensors result in a highly multimodal function. The algorithm is designed to find the global peak of this function efficiently and accurately. The algorithm starts as a deterministic global optimization algorithm known as DIRECT (DIviding RECTangles). With DIRECT, a lower bound is found to the unknown function over increasingly smaller intervals. When the search interval reaches the scale of the carrier wavelength, the global search switches to a local search. It is shown that this approach speeds up convergence by a factor of two compared to DIRECT, and by many orders of magnitude compared to an exhaustive grid search.

articleTitle: Ground Control Station for an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Integrated in IoT
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper presents the Murros Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) and its integration in IoT. Murros UAS is a multisensorial robotic system used for aerial monitoring of wireless sensors network in precision agriculture. This document details the software and hardware architecture of Murros UAS Ground Control Station and common situations when we are operating in an over-the-internet configuration. Experimental results are obtained from real missions.

articleTitle: Agent for Preprocessing and Forecasting Time-Series Data
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Data aggregation is an important preprocessing step in knowledge discovery in databases collected from different sources. In this paper we propose an algorithm for currency data aggregation in order to learn with high accuracy the currency rate behavior and to increase the forecasting performance. The entire data mining process is automated and is monitored using a multi-agent system.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Computational Basic Models and Analysis for Power Delivery Safety and Efficiency Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper proposes to use computational methods for analysis of the Safety and Efficiency for a power delivery system from a real study case in Galati area. The analysis will consider dependability models like generalized stochastic Petri nets for safety analysis of the proposed study case, taking in consideration the failure-repair state-space events modeling. Economical benefits, after implementing the efficiency improving methods and the failure damages during an year are presented in the paper.

articleTitle: Determining the Risk Level Regarding to the Positioning of an Exam Machine Used in the Nuclear Environment, based of polynomial regression
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: In this paper is presented a computational algorithm, based on polynomial regression, used to predict the positioning of a universal exam machine. The universal exam machine works in nuclear environment, which makes it impossible to control using positioning sensors or cameras. In the same time, the exam machine is used for non-destructive analysis of nuclear materials. The exam machine operates with a stepper motor. The control parameters of the stepper motor have resulted from different conditions operation of stepper motor. Based on these parameters, a predictive polynomial method was developed to optimize the positioning of the exam machine controlling the stepper motor. This method is trained off-line using previously acquired data. This method is a part of predictive machine learning that is trained offline using previously acquired data. For hardware validation is implemented a circuit that use current sensors coupled to each phase of the stepper motor. The information received from those current sensors is sufficient to achieve, based on the prediction method, a very accurate prediction system respecting operating conditions of the exam machine.

articleTitle: A group decision approach based on rough multi-attribute methods for Cloud Services Provider selection
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper proposes a new group decision approach that takes into account uncertainty, to solve the problem of selection of the best Cloud Services Provider (CSP). Uncertainty is modeled and analyzed by rough sets to handle imprecise evaluations of cloud experts or decision makers. The approach is based on two multi-attribute decision methods that are combined into a hybrid method. The methods are rough Analytic Hierarchy Process - AHP method and rough Simple Additive Weight - SAW method. The subjectively weights associated with the criteria are calculated based on AHP rough method. Based on rough SAW method, the solution of the CSP selection problem is obtained, taking into account the uncertainty present in the CSPs evaluations. The proposed approach is exemplified by a case study to valid its applicability. The case study is based on the opinions of a set of cloud experts.

articleTitle: Developing foreign language communication skills for the future teachers using the digital resources
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The professional profile of the teacher is also defined by the competence of communication in a foreign language, this being one of the main means of the professional communication, which allows to any specialist in the education to share and develop the relevant professional experiences. To learn the foriegn languages in the university programmes involves the pedagogical organization of the educational process by designing a set of educational conditions that promote the effective implementation of the educational objectives, associated with the support of modern didactic technologies, with the activation of the personal potential of the students in the personal effort to build communication skills. The paper focuses on taking into account the modern teaching practice of a foreign language, where the emphasis is on the use of modern technologies that allow the implementation of the various innovations currently available in the educational process. Apparently, the traditional approaches have proven to be ineffective in building this competence, therefore the use of the modern technologies and open educational resources proved to be more useful. We will also analyze the process of teaching foreign languages through digital resources, included in the manuals proposed by publishers for studying French as a foreign language, highlighting the importance of interactive pedagogical tools used for the development of communication skills in a foreign language. The conclusions of the paper emphasize the importance of using modern technology (web resources, open resources, interactive play strategies) and their role in developing the language skills of the future teachers.

articleTitle: Animatronic Robot Humanoid Head with 7 DOF: Design and Experimental Set-Up
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: A robotic head has been designed and built in order to accomplish communication purposes such as moving eyes and eyelids, opening and closing the mouth, bending and turning the head to the left and to the right. The mechanisms are driven by stepper and servo motors and are controlled by a specially designed circuit.

articleTitle: Applying Neural Network Approach to Homomorphic Encrypted Data
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Nowadays, a new era is beginning, the Data Era, which comes with a multitude of challenges and opportunities. Due to technology advancement and increased demand for powerful computing resources, many organizations outsource their storage and computing services to providers of such services. The benefits of cloud computing are numerous, but the security of cloud stored data remains an important issue. Cyber-attacks can be hard to detect and the culprits hard to identify, which encourages the cyber attackers to further pursue their malicious purposes. Big Data combined with analytical methods can produce the best defensive techniques against intrusions in the cyber security domain. Neural networks are not yet feasible to work over encrypted data, but with a well-designed architecture for such an analytical method they can contribute to the security of a system. Our paper aims to present a solution for the protection of personal data in insecure environments, which can also use the same data to perform analytical tasks without affecting confidentiality and security of individuals.

articleTitle: Black Hole vs Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The nature inspired (NI) algorithms have demonstrated their capabilities in solving optimization problems in many domains with the advantage that the solution is obtained faster than using the classical methods. Almost every time a new NI algorithm is proposed the author claims that it is more efficient than other algorithms at least in solving a particular type of problem. Some of them are quite controversial in terms of both performance and novelty. In this paper the capabilities of the Black Hole Algorithm (BHA) are compared to those of Particle Swarm (PSO) and one of its variants - Multi Swarm optimization (MSO). The usage of a movement step scaling factor that leads to BHA performance improvement is proposed. The evaluation was done using a set of benchmark functions. In terms of precision of the results, for low-dimensional problems, PSO and BHA precision is higher than that of MSO, while for high-dimensional problems MSO and BHA perform better than PSO.

articleTitle: Measuring and detecting blood glucose by methods non-invasive
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This article aims to discuss the detection and measurement of blood glucose by non-invasive methods, current or older blood glucose measurement methods, current and future research. The article aims to illustrate a new prototype based on spectroscopic methods, UV sensors, to monitor blood glucose. The problems addressed center on the absorption of light in the matter and the measurement of blood glucose.

articleTitle: A Biometric System with Hierarchical Feature-level Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: The paper approaches the feature-level fusion for biometric authentication, a big challenge for the actual biometric security systems design. A hierarchical inter-modal fusion method is proposed and evaluated for a reduced feature space. The feature generation and fusion are performed using regions of interest manually defined within the original images. The features are extracted using co-occurrence matrices, providing a common framework for feature generation among several human traits. The fusion is based on a functional combination of the features, an approach that is feasible if the feature vectors are homogeneous. The functional fusion avoids the concatenation that increases the feature space size, leading to curse of dimensionality and additional computational complexity costs.

articleTitle: Combining Artificial Intelligence planning advantages to assist preliminary formal analysis on Industrial Control System cybersecurity vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: This paper provides a novel and practical approach, to check the correctness and completeness of functional specifications (the completeness means complete for one specified function), especially for complex safety critical systems. This approach combines Artificial Intelligence (AI) planning technique, together with formal functional specification, to assist further cybersecurity vulnerability analysis on safety critical Industrial Control System (ICS). The effectiveness of this combination is represented by examples, which are based on a safety critical ICS-Refueling Machine (RM). RMs are widely used in Nuclear Power Plants (NPPs). The outcome of this idea is a correct and complete functional specification of specific functions, which is the key foundation for our further safety and security vulnerability analysis, especially for performing analysis based on model checking. This practical checking approach is applicable to further Instrumentation & Control (I&C) systems and platforms.

articleTitle: Trajectory influence on data collection in Wireless Sensor Networks using an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
abstract: Data collection is one of the most important parts in the communication process of wireless sensors. Without a proper mechanism to gather data, any further action is inefficient. Data aggregation, processing and decision making are only possible after data is collected. For this reason, this paper studies the impact of trajectories on data collection in an environment where a mobile unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed to gather information from ground sensors. Different mobility patterns have been taken into consideration to observe how collection efficiency is affected. Simulations were deployed in Network Simulator 2, version 2.34 and results are revealed in Section IV.

articleTitle: Task of Energy Router in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2018 10th International Conference on Electronics, Computers and Artificial Intelligence (ECAI)
